tactics:
induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
    congr 1
    funext o
    cases o with
    | none => exact ih acc
    | some b => rw [ih (b :: acc), ih [b]]; simp [Functor.map_map]

induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
    apply congrArg
    funext o
    cases o <;> simp only [] <;> first | exact ih acc | (rw [ih (_ :: acc), ih [_]]; simp [Functor.map_map])
induction l generalizing acc <;> simp [List.filterMapM.loop] <;> grind
